description_rules: Each description expands the Stimuli, Task Requirements and Response columns of WJ IV Technical Abstract Tables 11-13 (LaForte, McGrew & Schrank, 2014) into one or two sentences of at most 40 words, in the third person beginning 'The examinee', with no test name, no CHC label, no construct words (memory, reasoning, fluency, processing, attention, speed as a noun), and no verbatim items, stimuli or scoring keys.

excluded.name: Verbal Attention
excluded.reason: Working memory capacity: "technically not a narrow ability (WMC = short-term storage + AC)" (Schneider, 2017). Not in inventory.

excluded.reason: Working memory capacity: "technically not a narrow ability (WMC = short-term storage + AC)" (Schneider, 2017). Not in inventory.

tests.name: Oral Vocabulary
tests.description: The examinee hears a word and verbally provides both a synonym and an antonym aloud.
tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.name: Number Series
tests.description: The examinee is presented with numbers, identifies a sequence with one or more numbers missing, and verbally states the numbers.
tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.name: Letter-Pattern Matching
tests.description: The examinee is presented with letters and quickly identifies and circles identical letters or patterns.
tests.provenance: written by the PI (moved from the note field)

tests.name: Phonological Processing
tests.description: The examinee listens to words and responds verbally by saying a word that contains a given sound, listing all the words they can that start with a given sound, and creating a new word by changing part of another word.
tests.provenance: corrected by Claude at the PI's request (first part matched to source)

tests.name: Story Recall
tests.description: The examinee listens to stories and tells the story in detail again.
tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.name: Visualization
tests.description: The examinee views shapes and designs, identifies two-dimensional pieces that make a shape and two rotated three-dimensional block arrangements matching a target, and responds by saying the matching target.
tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.name: General Information
tests.description: The examinee hears questions about an object, where an object is typically found, and how people would use it, then answers aloud in phrases or sentences.
tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.name: Concept Formation
tests.description: The examinee views drawings, identifying what they show as a pattern, grouping them into categories, and determining rules.
tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.name: Number-Pattern Matching
tests.description: The examinee is shown an image set of numbers and rapidly locates identical numbers, marking them by rotating.
tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.name: Nonword Repetition
tests.description: The examinee listens to a made-up word and says it aloud without changing it.
tests.provenance: model example selected unedited by the PI

tests.name: Visual-Auditory Learning
tests.description: The examinee hears words while being shown their picture symbols, then is asked to give the words depicted in the pictures as spoken sentences.
tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.name: Picture Recognition
tests.description: The examinee is shown pictures, then selects those shown before from a group containing similar distractors.
tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.name: Analysis-Synthesis
tests.description: The examinee views drawings of puzzles and uses symbolic expressions to find the missing parts.
tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.name: Pair Cancellation
tests.description: The examinee is shown drawings and quickly finds a pattern that appears more than once.
tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.name: Memory for Words
tests.description: The examinee listens to words that are unrelated to one another and repeats them in the same order.
tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.name: Picture Vocabulary
tests.description: The examinee views pictures and says a word that describes the objects they show.
tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.name: Oral Comprehension
tests.description: The examinee listens to a passage and finds a missing word that fits its meaning.
tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.name: Segmentation
tests.description: The examinee listens to a word and orally gives its syllables or phonemes.
tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.name: Rapid Picture Naming
tests.description: The examinee is shown pictures of objects and is asked to say what they are called, giving their names aloud rapidly.
tests.provenance: model example selected unedited by the PI

tests.name: Sentence Repetition
tests.description: The examinee hears words and sentences and repeats each word, phrase, or sentence in the order presented.
tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.name: Sound Blending
tests.description: The examinee listens to individual sounds and combines them into a word, responding aloud.
tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.name: Sound Awareness
tests.description: The examinee listens to spoken questions and words, says a rhyming word, and removes word parts to form a new word.
tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.name: Letter-Word Identification
tests.description: The examinee sees letters and words in print and names the letters and reads the words aloud.
tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.name: Applied Problems
tests.description: The examinee hears math questions and sees numbers and text, carries out the calculations required by the spoken problems, and answers using numbers and words.
tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.name: Spelling
tests.description: The examinee listens to spoken words and spells them in writing.
tests.provenance: model example selected unedited by the PI

tests.name: Passage Comprehension
tests.description: The examinee views a passage with a missing key word and says a word that makes the passage make sense.
tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.name: Calculation
tests.description: The examinee is shown numbers, performs calculations, and writes the answers.
tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.name: Writing Samples
tests.description: The examinee is presented with spoken and written text and responds by writing meaningful sentences suited to a stated purpose.
tests.provenance: model example selected unedited by the PI

tests.name: Word Attack
tests.description: The examinee sees made-up words with regular pronunciation rules and reads them aloud.
tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.name: Oral Reading
tests.description: The examinee is shown written sentences and reads them aloud accurately and with a smooth delivery.
tests.provenance: model example selected unedited by the PI

tests.name: Sentence Reading Fluency

tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.provenance: model example selected unedited by the PI

tests.name: Sentence Writing Fluency
tests.description: The examinee is shown pictures with words and rapidly composes simple sentences in writing.

tests.name: Reading Recall
tests.description: The examinee reads stories presented as text and gives an oral account of their details.
tests.provenance: model example selected unedited by the PI

tests.name: Number Matrices
tests.description: The examinee is shown numbers in a two-dimensional arrangement, determines their pattern, and says missing numbers.
tests.provenance: written or edited by the PI

tests.name: Editing
tests.description: The examinee is shown passages of text, identifies errors, and states the corrections aloud in sentences.
tests.provenance: model example selected unedited by the PI

tests.name: Word Reading Fluency
tests.description: The examinee rapidly reads rows of words and uses slash marks to indicate the two words in each row that have related meanings.
tests.provenance: model example selected unedited by the PI

tests.name: Spelling of Sounds
tests.description: The examinee hears letters and words and writes spellings that follow regular English letter patterns.
tests.provenance: model example selected unedited by the PI

tests.name: Reading Vocabulary
tests.description: The examinee is shown words, reads them, and responds aloud with a suitable word that has the same or opposite meaning.
tests.provenance: model example selected unedited by the PI

tests.name: Science
tests.description: The examinee is shown text and pictures, hears science questions, and gives spoken answers in words or sentences.
tests.provenance: model example selected unedited by the PI
